proof.observed: All 8 pass at head. Listener outage: bob's 3 keystrokes on B reached alice on A 1.36 s after the outage began, with no reconnect and no room close. A close through B during a second outage closed alice's room after the redial, and she reconnected read-only. Concurrent typing: editors and API reads on A and B converged to 60 a and 60 b, counters 0/0. SIGKILL: a tab that joins A 47 s later is not shown bob, so the room forgot him; an agent write through A answered 200 in 72 ms. Sender killed: the next cursor reached B within 1 s. SIGSTOP: alice's keystrokes stored in 13-14 ms; the agent write answered 200 in 1.59 s; after SIGCONT, bob caught up in 10 ms with no reconnect. SIGTERM: bob's presence left alice in 80 ms and his last keystroke was kept. Toggles: the last change wins on both processes. Refusals (401 and 404) carry X-Dispatch-Process on A and B.
proof.negativeControl: The same probes at aa50b68c: concurrent typing fails with 'write: broken pipe' (room closed); SIGKILL and SIGTERM fail with the cursor never crossing; SIGSTOP fails with alice's keystroke not stored within 5 s.
